description: MCM QA flake registry. Tracks tests with known intermittent failure patterns. Each entry requires a root cause, reproduction rate estimate, and resolution owner.

entries.test: typography: body font on all pages
entries.root_cause: Playwright win-arm64 canvas build fails — suite cannot run. All tests in this file are blocked, not flaky by design.
entries.resolution: Resolve win-arm64 canvas/playwright build. Owner: GP.

entries.root_cause: Same as flake-001 — Playwright runtime blocked on win-arm64.
entries.resolution: Resolve win-arm64 canvas/playwright build. Owner: GP.

entries.test: shuffle produces unique orderings across seeds
entries.root_cause: SHA-256 hash collision probability is negligible but non-zero. Test uses 100 seeds; at 10! orderings the collision floor is ~0%. In practice: no failures observed.
entries.resolution: None needed. Document as acceptable probabilistic pass.

entries.root_cause: Test reads data/kai-scores-2026-02-22.json as fixture. If that file is deleted or renamed, test fails. Not intermittent — deterministic on file presence.
entries.repro_rate: 0% if file present; 100% if file removed
entries.resolution: Add fixture presence check to pre-commit guard. Owner: GF.

entries.root_cause: test writes to os.tmpdir() — concurrent test runs from two agents could collide on the temp filename. Mitigated by random suffix in filename.
entries.resolution: None needed. Random suffix + Date.now() makes collision effectively impossible.
